research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Qolo is focused on enhancing large-scale transaction systems through the development of an Intelligent Wire Transfer Automation System. This system streamlines payments by utilizing pseudo and provisional accounts to manage and mark invoices as paid upon successful matching. The innovation aims to refine the payment process for businesses, aligning with Qolo's mission to facilitate payments and reduce expenses.
